reference_benchmarks.name: CMI-Bench
reference_benchmarks.conclusion: Audio-text LLMs significantly trail task-specific supervised MIR systems on standard exact-MIR metrics and exhibit demographic/cultural/chronological biases.
reference_benchmarks.product_implication: Do not promote audio-language answers to exact musical facts without task-level validation against specialized evidence.

reference_benchmarks.name: MUSE
reference_benchmarks.conclusion: Large audio-language systems show a persistent human gap; Qwen2.5-Omni and Audio Flamingo 3 are at or near chance on several music perception/relational tasks, and chain-of-thought prompting is inconsistent.
reference_benchmarks.product_implication: Relational claims remain hypotheses unless separately validated or grounded in trusted evidence.

architecture_recommendation: Research-only evidence-grounded multimodal Ask path; audio-language outputs remain SemanticHypothesis-class evidence unless exact-task evaluation proves otherwise.
